text:
Four power banks with 25W Qi2.2 or Qi2 25W wireless charging turned up in the search results, and one more is sold only in Japan.

**Available or orderable in the US**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2-certified, with 25W wireless and 45W wired USB-C output. The Baseus site lists it at $59.99 (Amazon is $79.99). A Dealectric page says code AM52 takes $6 off, to $53.99, and that it was tested in Baseus's cart today, though checkout has the final word. [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) (affiliate link; Dealectric earns a commission). Details are on the [product page](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) and in [Notebookcheck's launch report](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html).
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** 25W Qi2.2, 45W USB-C in and out, and an active cooling fan. It costs $109.99 and is a pre-order that ships Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm current US availability or price**
- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W:** billed as the first Qi2.2-certified power bank (WPC), planned for Amazon and UGREEN's site in Q3 2025. I don't have a product page or price for it. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** 13.8 mm thick with Qi2 25W, previewed at CES 2026 for Amazon and ESR's site. The release says "Qi2 25W" rather than "Qi2.2" explicitly. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

**Japan only:** the CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K is Qi2.2 25W, but the [release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html) covers only Japanese retailers.

**Compatibility:** 25W needs an iPhone 16 or 17 (not the 16e) on recent iOS. Per Baseus, iPhone 12–15 get 15W. Notebookcheck says the Pixel 10 Pro XL also supports Qi2.2.

For a US purchase today, the Baseus AM52 is the cheaper option, while the Anker MagGo 2 Pro costs more and adds active cooling.
